sv.title: Spiltan blir delägare i hudvårdsmärke
sv.summary: Per H Börjessons investmentbolag Spiltan förvärvar 21,3 procent av hudvårdsmärket Common Clouds genom en nyemission. ”Common Clouds har på kort tid byggt ett starkt varumärke med lojala kunder, och dessutom gjort det lönsamt”, kommenterar Fanny Lundsgård, Investment Manager på Spiltan Invest.

en.title: Spiltan becomes co-owner of skincare brand
en.summary: Per H Börjesson's investment company Spiltan acquires 21.3 percent of the skincare brand Common Clouds through a new share issue. “Common Clouds has in a short time built a strong brand with loyal customers, and also made it profitable”, comments Fanny Lundsgård, Investment Manager at Spiltan Invest.
